name: ConditionsToIcd10
title: Conditions translated to ICD-10
description: Translates each condition's SNOMED CT code to ICD-10 by left-joining the conditions view to a concept map dependency, exposed under the sct_to_icd10 label as a relation with one row per mapping. The LEFT JOIN keeps conditions the map does not translate, and the relationship predicate in the ON clause excludes not-related-to mappings while admitting the null relationship of a noMap row. Author: John Grimes.

relatedArtifact.label: conditions
relatedArtifact.display: Condition view with patient_id, system, version and code columns

relatedArtifact.label: sct_to_icd10
relatedArtifact.display: SNOMED CT to ICD-10 concept map, exposed as a relation

extension.valueString:
SELECT conditions.patient_id,
       conditions.code,
       sct_to_icd10.target_code,
       sct_to_icd10.relationship
FROM conditions
LEFT JOIN sct_to_icd10
  ON sct_to_icd10.source_system = conditions.system
 AND sct_to_icd10.source_code = conditions.code
 AND (sct_to_icd10.relationship IS NULL
      OR sct_to_icd10.relationship <> 'not-related-to')
ORDER BY conditions.patient_id, conditions.code
